'''People''' is the index of every person with a page on this wiki: players, [[Decipher]] staff, [[Players Committee]] advocates and volunteers, [[Squadron Members]], webmasters, deck authors and content creators. It lists 2,125 people pages, split alphabetically by surname. Each letter page is a sortable table giving the person's country or region where the biography states it, what the person is known for, and the years their page covers.

== Notable groups ==
* [[Creators of SWCCG]] – [[Decipher]] designers, developers and staff who made the game
* [[Players Committee advocates]] – the volunteer officers of the [[Players Committee]], with [[Players Committee organization history]] and the office of [[Advocate]]
* [[Championships]] – World, national and continental champions; see also [[European Championships]] and [[List of SWCCG tournaments]]
* [[Squadron Members]] – Decipher's volunteer tournament and demo program
* [[Star Wars CCG teams]] – playtest and travel teams: [[Team 5]], [[Team Albany]], [[Endor Gentleman's Club]], [[High Ground]], [[It Could Be Worse (team)|It Could Be Worse]], [[Jedi Test 8]], [[Kashyyyk Train of Dominance]], [[Killer Bees]], [[M.E.T.]], [[Moneyball]], [[New Allies]], [[Team OK-UK]]; [[Outrider Cup]] squads [[Team Europe]] and [[Team USA]]
* [[List of Retro League participants]] – players in the [[Retro League]] on [[GEMP]]
* [[Unknown players]] – event-sheet entries that do not identify a person
* [[Podcasts, video and interviews]] – podcasters, streamers, video makers and interviews; see also [[Fan sites]]
* Deck authors on [[DeckTech]], [[Game Players Network decks|Game Players Network]] and [[Trandosite]]
